decision: ENSv2 first-prize prototype uses Sepolia; namespace ownership is distinct from scientific or institutional accreditation
transport: Fixed public Sepolia RPC; failure grants no authority; no automatic CCIP gateway requests
contracts: Only pinned static protocol runtimes and factory-verified proxies with pinned implementations are accepted
name_profile: Explicit normalized ASCII .eth names, maximum six labels; wildcard/inherited resolvers and other implementations remain unsupported
delegation_policy: PermissionedResolver setter scopes are record-key-wide across the instance. Require isolated resolver boundaries and real sibling/root negative transactions before claiming isolation. A dedicated-looking address alone is insufficient proof.
observation_policy: Read all hierarchy states, current owner, expiry, mutable token/resource, resolver and text records at one finalized block; record block hash and recheck it at end
registration_offer: ETHGlobal free-domain redemption is not accepted as proof of network, ownership, delegation or ENSv2 use
production_effect: None: read-only CLI is not wired into eligibility and is not deployed to Oracle yet
gate: F03 incomplete; no advance to F04
